title: What Happens When You Shove Drugs in a Cop's Face
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On April 15, 2023, police monitoring parking ramp cameras observed people blocking stairwells with belongings in La Crosse, WI. They eventually encountered a woman screaming from an elevator, where she attempted to use drugs upon seeing the officers. During her arrest, she resisted, smearing the drugs in the officer's face, and ingested them to prevent confiscation. Following the arrest, the officers noticed that both their gloves and the woman were damp, with surveillance footage later unveiling the reason for this.

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
